strategy.primary: +1/+1-counter aristocrats: put counters on creatures (dethrone, Thran Vigil, Metallic Mimic, Forge of Heroes), sacrifice them for mana, cards and damage, let Marchesa return countered creatures at end step, and use counters to reset persist creatures into sacrifice loops.
strategy.secondary: Drain payoffs (Blood Artist, Mayhem Devil, Gray Merchant, Syr Konrad, Grave Pact) and Sneak Attack/Imperial Recruiter to find loop pieces.

commander_oracle_snapshots.name: Marchesa, the Black Rose
commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
Dethrone (Whenever this creature attacks the player with the most life or tied for most life, put a +1/+1 counter on it.)
Other creatures you control have dethrone.
Whenever a creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it dies, return that card to the battlefield under your control at the beginning of the next end step.

identity.why: Team dethrone and end-step return for countered creatures.
Counter source that turns persist creatures into loops.
Persist damage creature at the centre of the kills.
